- Added compiled Python bytecode files for key scripts in scripts/__pycache__ (burn_subtitles, dashscope_api, generate_video).
- Removed the skill-card.md file.
- No functional logic changes; update mainly involves added build and cache artifacts.

video-creator 1.0.0

- Initial release of the video-creator skill for automatic product introduction video generation.
- Supports TTS voice synthesis (custom "my voice" cloning, Edge-TTS male/female voices), and automatic voice cloning from URL or local audio file.
- Generates slideshow videos from user-provided images (no large model video generation) and creates SRT subtitles in sync with the audio (options: soft, hard, none).
- Introduces "face-to-camera" (口播) video generation when the first script segment begins with "口播：" or similar, combining a real person's photo with TTS audio.
- Comprehensive user guidance for gathering required parameters (voice, subtitle choice, images, portrait photo) before processing.
- Includes detailed CLI parameter mapping, workflow, and error handling for missing information or misaligned assets.
